    *   Calculation: $-1 / 56 \approx -0.017857$ (or -1.79%)

    *   Alternatively: $Value_{2017} + (Value_{2017} \times GrowthRate)$ which simplifies to $Value_{2017} \times (Value_{2017} / Value_{2016})$
